intent: Specify the public API of `dlt_parse::storage::StorageHeader` (the DLT storage header): `StorageHeader::to_bytes`, `StorageHeader::from_bytes`, the constants `PATTERN_AT_START` and `BYTE_LEN`, and the derived `PartialEq::eq` and `Clone::clone` of `StorageHeader`.

manual_mutants.note: microseconds decoded from a duplicated byte: wrong only when bytes 10 and 11 differ
error reports the expected instead of the actual pattern
pattern check ignores the version byte (byte 3)
microseconds big-endian on the wire (from_bytes unchanged)

bug_variants.source: https://github.com/JulianSchmid/dlt-parse-rs/commit/d0c00e53f9b3896d4162f9e65d1ee6863f5e4afe ('fixed timestamp endianess bug'; endianness then settled to little endian in 86780505487d1f4c6b5dfa3d0008d4685736db77). Pre-fix to_bytes from 416ec52 (src/storage.rs, later moved to src/storage/storage_header.rs)
bug_variants.note: to_bytes serialises timestamp_seconds / timestamp_microseconds big-endian while from_bytes decodes them little-endian: from_bytes(to_bytes(h)) != h for most timestamps, so headers written by the crate are read back with garbled timestamps

edits.with_text:
def storage.storage_header.StorageHeader.to_bytes
  (self : storage.storage_header.StorageHeader) : RustM (Array Std.U8 16#usize) := do
  let ts ← core.num.U32.to_be_bytes self.timestamp_seconds
  let tms ← core.num.U32.to_be_bytes self.timestamp_microseconds
  let i ← Array.index_usize storage.storage_header.StorageHeader.PATTERN_AT_START 0#usize
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize storage.storage_header.StorageHeader.PATTERN_AT_START 1#usize
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize storage.storage_header.StorageHeader.PATTERN_AT_START 2#usize
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize storage.storage_header.StorageHeader.PATTERN_AT_START 3#usize
  let i4 ← Array.index_usize ts 0#usize
  let i5 ← Array.index_usize ts 1#usize
  let i6 ← Array.index_usize ts 2#usize
  let i7 ← Array.index_usize ts 3#usize
  let i8 ← Array.index_usize tms 0#usize
  let i9 ← Array.index_usize tms 1#usize
  let i10 ← Array.index_usize tms 2#usize
  let i11 ← Array.index_usize tms 3#usize
  let i12 ← Array.index_usize self.ecu_id 0#usize
  let i13 ← Array.index_usize self.ecu_id 1#usize
  let i14 ← Array.index_usize self.ecu_id 2#usize
  let i15 ← Array.index_usize self.ecu_id 3#usize
  ok
    (Array.make 16#usize [
      i, i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, i6, i7, i8, i9, i10, i11, i12, i13, i14, i15
      ])
